hero.title: Care is a conversation.
hero.description: From finding a time to knowing what comes next. A shared space for patients, clinicians and the people who bring care together.
hero.footnote: No account needed · All sample data
hero.caption: A familiar face. A clearer next step.

recordItems: Next steps kept in one place

journey.title: Care moves forward.
journey.description: Follow Alex’s appointment as the same details move from a patient’s day into a clinician’s workspace — and back again.

stages.label: Find your time
stages.title:
A little space
for your health.
stages.body: Start with a familiar name and a time that fits. The appointment details stay together from here.

stages.label: Arrive understood
stages.title:
The story arrives
before you do.
stages.body: The same appointment lands in the clinician’s day, alongside the reason for the visit. No starting from a blank page.

stages.label: Have a conversation
stages.title:
Less in the way.
More face to face.
stages.body: A calm consultation space keeps the person in focus and the appointment context within reach.

stages.label: Know what’s next
stages.title:
A conversation ends.
The care continues.
stages.body: A place for the conversation’s next steps. This sample follow-up shows the structure, not a real clinician’s advice.

workspace.eyebrow: A DIFFERENT VIEW. THE SAME CARE.
workspace.title: Step into the other side.
workspace.description: Change a time as a patient. See it update for the clinician. Coordinate the same visit as staff. Try it — the sample is yours to explore.

roles.subtitle: A little clarity for the day ahead.

roles.name: Clinician
roles.title: Start with the whole picture.
roles.body: Review a sample queue, visit context and consultation space.
roles.subtitle: The people behind today’s appointments.

roles.name: Staff
roles.title: Keep care moving.
roles.body: Coordinate the same appointment and see its status update everywhere.
roles.subtitle: One shared appointment. Clear coordination.
